CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_GRP__JobParentsByControllingCustomerAndAgent1] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT E2.ParentID AS E2_ParentID, MAX(CASE WHEN E2.AddressType = 'CAG' THEN OH.OrganizationID END) AS CAG, MAX(CASE WHEN E2.AddressType = 'CAG' THEN OH.FullName END) AS CAGOrgName, MAX(CASE WHEN E2.AddressType = 'SCP' THEN OH.OrganizationID END) AS CCB, MAX(CASE WHEN E2.AddressType = 'SCP' THEN OH.FullName END) AS CCBOrgName FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__ControllingCustomerAndAgentAddress E2 LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__OrganizationAddress OA ON E2.OrganizationAddressKey = OA.OrganizationAddressKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization OH ON OA.OrganizationKey = OH.OrganizationKey GROUP BY E2.ParentID
